title: Servicing Fee Set-Aside — Monthly Fee Draw Rules
content:
Under Set-Aside Accounts, only plans that draw the servicing fee pay the HECM monthly servicing fee; that plan is the Servicing Fee Set-Aside.

- **Matching draw.** Each servicing fee posted on the loan is drawn from the loan's Servicing Fee Set-Aside on the same date, for the same amount and the same fee month, referencing that fee.
- **Status.** A fee draw is made only while the set-aside status is active.
- **Short balance.** When the balance is smaller than the fee, the draw takes the remaining balance and the set-aside depletes. From then on, under the plan's exhaustion setting, fees are still charged to the loan balance but nothing is drawn.
- **Once per month.** Each fee month is drawn at most once; a fee month already showing a fee draw on the set-aside's ledger is not drawn again.

Stated as a quantity: the fee draw equals the lesser of the posted servicing fee and the set-aside balance.

## Hypothetical illustration

| Posted fee | Balance before | Draw | Balance after | Status after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 35.00 | 400.00 | 35.00 | 365.00 | Active |
| 35.00 | 20.00 | 20.00 | 0.00 | Depleted |
| 35.00 | 0.00 (depleted) | none | 0.00 | Depleted; the fee stays on the loan balance |
